> **This fork (eroobeeroo/idrive7-apps) carries only eDrive Live** (`apps/edrive2`), **Cluster Info**
> (`apps/cluster_info`: a panel of live values and turn signal arrows over the Waze map) **and Light Show**
> (`apps/light_show`: exterior lamp patterns through the body controller's lamp test functions) and the renderer
> and controller gate they need. Every other app comes from the original,
> [cauliflowermossgrape/idrive7-apps](https://github.com/cauliflowermossgrape/idrive7-apps), so the MGU Store
> lists each app once.
